Data

Stat

A single impact figure with uppercase label. Compose 3–4 in a flex/grid band to show the Rede reach.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Stat

Impact figures — the "resultado" pillar made visible. Always compose 3–4 in a row with gap: var(--rse-space-7), never a single lonely stat.

<div style={{display:'grid',gridTemplateColumns:'repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr))',gap:'var(--rse-space-7)'}}>
  <Stat value="000" label="Escolas e unidades" accent="primary" />
  <Stat value="00%" label="Aprovação das famílias" accent="green" />
  <Stat value="00" label="Estados participantes" accent="orange" />
</div>
  • On a purple band use accent="inverse" for every stat in the group.
  • Vary accent hues across a group (the "rede" palette) but keep one shade family per group.
  • accent="yellow" renders in --rse-color-tint-yellow-ink (the derived yellow ink, themed): no official yellow reaches 3:1 on cream, so the figure would not be readable in the brand yellow.
  • Numbers must be real and attributable; never invent figures as visual filler.

Plain HTML contract

<div class="rse-stat rse-stat--green rse-stat--center">
  <span class="rse-stat__value">[Dado a confirmar]</span>
  <span class="rse-stat__label">Escolas e unidades</span>
  <p class="rse-stat__description">Confirme o dado e a fonte antes da publicação.</p>
</div>

Accent modifiers match the React accent prop; --sm and --lg change the figure size, and --center centres the group. The default size is medium and alignment is left. Accent colours use themed text roles; indigo uses the indigo/link-hover role (light indigo, adapted in other themes). React forwards the ref and native div attributes to the root, and merges className. All figures in examples require verification.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
valueReact.ReactNodeyesThe figure itself, pre-formatted: 1.200, 97%, +38 mil
labelstringyesShort uppercase label under the figure
descriptionstring—Optional supporting sentence
accentprimary indigo pink orange green blue yellow inverse—Figure colour — use inverse on purple bands
alignleft center—
sizesm md lg—

Also accepts every attribute of React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, a ref and className.
